newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BLUE CHIPS CONTINUE GAINS IN MIXED MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BLUE CHIPS CONTINUE GAINS IN MIXED MARKET.

text.p: * Vilniaus Bank , Hermis Bank and
Rokishkis Cheese advanced in brisk trade.
* Blue chip official list shares bounded up 25.95 points to
1043.67 points.
* Wider group A index slipped 13.13 points to 1833.91
points.
* Central market turnover rebounded to a healthy one million
litas from 754,000 litas.
* Brokers see continued gains for blue chips and mixed
trading elsewhere this week.
(A full report to follow.)
Vilniaus and Hermis banks maintained their ascent to new heights by the close of trade on Monday and brokers said rising share prices may continue to boost the market this week.
The blue chip official list bounded up 25.95 points to 1043.67 points, while the wider group A index floundered down 13.13 points to 1833.91 points.
Central market turnover rebounded to a healthy one million litas from 754,000 litas by the close.
"Turnover is increasing and this shows interest in the market is increasing and will only continue to increase in the future," one broker said.
Brokers said an undervalued market and solid six-month results were driving investors, who have been reluctant about the Vilnius bourse for most of the spring and summer.
Dealers also said that leading shares were shadowing each other.
"If Hermis Bank increases, then Vilniaus Bank follows; if Vilniaus Bank increases, then Hermis follows," one trader said.
Vilniaus Bank advanced to 275.10 litas from its former best of 260 litas in 93,000 litas central market turnover.

Brokers said Vilniaus Bank is being helped by its 21.7 million litas six-month profits for 1997, which were up from 11.7 million litas in the same period last year. They say low domestic supply is also driving up the price of its shares.

Rival Hermis Bank advanced to 255 litas from 250.20 litas in a heavy 264,000 litas turnover on the central market and saw block trades worth 128,000 litas at prices ranging from 25 litas to 255 litas.
One broker said the 25 litas was probably a technical transfer of shares and would not bring down the price.
"Hermis will reach 260 litas, maybe 265 litas or 270 litas," one broker said.

Official list corporate share Rokishkis gained modestly to 45.50 litas from 45 litas in central market turnover of 174,000 litas. Rokishkis shares turned over a whopping 855,000 litas in block trades at prices ranging from 44.90 litas to 45.28 litas.
Brokers say Rokishkis shares have long-term potential but that prices are being kept down by large block deals going through below the central market price.
-- Burton Frierson, Vilnius newsroom + 370 2 22 35 18
